stories.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln returns home to San Diego Bay
stories.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned home after a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea supporting the Iran war. The extended deployment drew attention following reports of crew stress and supply shortages.

stories.title: How long will the global energy crunch last?
stories.description: High energy prices continue to drive inflation and stoke anger among voters around the world. But with more crude oil flowing through the Strait of Hormuz, and governments releasing more emergency fuel stockpiles, how long will the energy crunch last?

stories.title: Trump says US will not strike Iran before midterm elections
